facts.fact: 10/12 起的两周：Milo 几乎寸步不离——他的过度保护不是没道理。
facts.anchor: For the following two weeks, Milo barely leaves my side.

facts.fact: Milo 留宿后夜袭停止——Peyton 追踪 Milo 的行踪和她一样勤，她不敢让继弟发现自己。
facts.anchor: Peyton and her goons haven’t paid me a single nightly visit since Milo started spending the night.

facts.fact: Max 的洞察：Peyton 敢害她，但不敢让 Milo 知道真相——「她最不想让 Milo 看见真实的自己」。
facts.anchor: Causing mayhem in my life is one thing. Risking Milo finding out she’s behind it is another.

facts.fact: Cushman 餐馆里 Kayla 整天玩手机——Max 战栗：不知道她在给谁发消息（红绳成员）。
facts.anchor: Kayla didn’t do much all night either.

facts.fact: Milo 发现 Peyton 房间里有她家的备用钥匙——在梳妆台上；他终于爆发质问。
facts.anchor: Mind telling me why my sister has a set of keys to your house?

facts.fact: 钥匙来源：Milo 被继母叫去 Peyton 房间拿卷发棒，撞见她的钥匙——Peyton 与 Misty 当晚有晚餐约。
facts.anchor: I found your keys on her vanity, Max.

facts.fact: Milo 崩溃低吼：你不告诉我，我怎么保护你？——两周看着她崩溃却不知原因。
facts.anchor: How the fuck am I supposed to protect you if you won’t talk to me?

facts.fact: 她转移话题：父亲明天回来、今晚是最后一夜——不想浪费在「不重要的事」上（继续隐瞒）。
facts.anchor: It’s our last night together. My father will be home tomorrow.

facts.fact: 她心里的真相：还未懂爱时，Milo 就拥有她的心——她嘴上说「这是给你的心」，那是谎。
facts.anchor: Milo Fletcher has had my heart since before I even knew what love meant.

facts.fact: 亲密时刻中 Milo 仍守底线：不想趁人之危——她回「那就趁吧」，他的克制是 ROM 线的道德锚。
facts.anchor: I don’t want to take advantage of the situation.

facts.fact: 清晨的告白：无论我在想什么，最后总会绕回你——简单得像这句「I'm simple」。
facts.anchor: no matter what’s on my mind, somehow it always comes back to you.

facts.fact: 父亲电话拆穿：Milo 骗说住 Dylan 家——父亲问「你的卡车怎么停在 Max 家门口」，他现编「Dylan 接我」。
facts.anchor: Why is my truck parked at Max’s?

facts.fact: 结局：Collins 上门送来征文获奖消息——证书+两千美元支票；她成了 published author。
章尾：昨夜吻了最爱的人，今天成了出版作家——也许宇宙终于肯放过我，只希望能持续。
facts.anchor: Maybe the universe has finally decided to give me a break. I can only hope it lasts.
